name: Armistice & Peace Conference (1918-11-11 onward)
description: The negotiations that will shape (or rewrite) the post-Great War order. Historical path excludes the Central Powers; alt-history paths require significant effort, especially via agents.
historical_note: In reality Germany, Austria-Hungary, and the Ottoman Empire were not seated as equals. This is a major divergence point.

central_powers_seating.label: Treatment of Central Powers at the Table

options.label: HISTORICAL — Full Exclusion
options.description: Germany, Austria-Hungary, and Ottoman Empire are dictated to with no substantive seat. Classic Versailles-style process.

options.label: Limited Observers
options.description: Central Powers granted observer status and limited voice on secondary matters.

options.label: Full Participants (Major Alt-History)
options.description: Central Powers seated as negotiating parties. Real concessions possible. High risk of Entente domestic backlash.

options.label: HISTORICAL — Harsh (Full Liability + Heavy Schedule)
options.description: Full war guilt, massive total, strict in-kind deliveries. Classic driver of later crises.

options.label: Moderate (Reduced Total, Longer Timeline)
options.description: Significant but survivable burden with more room for recovery.

options.label: Lenient / Reconstruction-Tied
options.description: Lower totals or payments linked to productive investment and trade. Much better long-term stability.

options.label: HISTORICAL — Strict Limits + Demilitarized Zones
options.description: Severe caps on army size, navy, air power, and forbidden zones. Strong tech gating for Germany.

options.label: Moderate Limits + Inspection Regime
options.description: Noticeable restrictions but with clearer path to revision.

options.label: Minimal / Symbolic
options.description: Largely face-saving limits. Major alt-history military recovery path opens early.

options.label: HISTORICAL — Full Alsace-Lorraine to FRA, Polish Corridor, mandates in Africa/ME
options.description: Classic carve-up. Seeds revanchism and instability in successor regions.

options.label: Moderate Revisions (some plebiscites or retained cores)
options.description: Reduced territorial penalties; alt-history path eases long-term claims.

options.label: HISTORICAL — Weak League (US absent, limited enforcement)
options.description: Toothless body. Good for revanchists later.

options.label: Stronger Structure / Regional Pacts
options.description: More effective (or more subvertable) international framework.

options.label: HISTORICAL — Explicit War Guilt + Article 231
options.description: Symbolic humiliation drives domestic politics for decades.

options.label: No Explicit Guilt / Shared Responsibility Language
options.description: Major alt-history softening; reduces radicalization fuel.

notes_for_implementation: Phase 0/1 data: 7 term buckets now (core + territorial/league/guilt). Resolution combines delegation score + pre-conference agent leverage + chosen terms + small random element. All historical options are explicitly flagged for UI badges and AI historical weighting. More (economic, Ottoman details) in Phase 6.

TUR.description: Ottoman Empire partitions into successor states and mandates. Player may choose to continue as the core Turkish Republic remnant or any of the new entities (historical or alt stash opportunities).

GER.description: German Empire heavily constrained; core GER tag remains primary playable remnant.
